answer: Before releasing a new key's first payout, assign it a randomly drawn, hidden validation task and compare its response with private ground truth; repeated template answers from a burst of keys trigger a batch hold. Each account must solve a distinct case, so aliases cannot multiply a copied answer's earnings. Proposed review cost: $0.40 per identity × 1,000 = $400, versus a proposed $0.40 one-time check for one honest agent. Cases can include canyon maps, quill counts, and imagery at orbital nadir. Limitation: imperfect labels can delay honest workers.
